purpose: Teach: ナンバーワン/しかるに/彷徨/踏み入れ/かなう/変人/親分/両足

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、部活のナンバーワン目指してたな
lines.en: You were really aiming to be number one in your club, weren't you.
lines.style: Warm observation, slightly teasing. Direct eye contact, the tone of someone who's been paying attention. Light and steady delivery, no edge.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、しかるにって古い言い回し使うな、桜
lines.en: Don't use old-fashioned words like that on me, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick, sardonic half-laugh. Shaking his head slightly. The tone of someone used to her tricks but amused by them anyway. Slight drawl on the complaint.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、放課後街を彷徨ってたな
lines.en: So you were wandering around town after school, huh.
lines.style: Sarcastic lilt. Casual, like she's caught him in something small and is enjoying it. Light pace, almost conversational. Eyebrow raise in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、教室に踏み入れる時挨拶しろ、桜
lines.en: You should at least say hi when you come into the classroom, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, straightforward. A mild complaint delivered without heat, the tone of someone too used to this to bother getting annoyed. Almost resigned affection underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の夢がかなうといいな
lines.en: I hope your dreams come true, Riku.
lines.style: Sincere, without fanfare. Slower pace than before. The words land softly — genuine underneath the usual banter. Slight warmth in the delivery, not pushing it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ちょっと変人だけど面白いな、桜
lines.en: You're kind of weird, but honestly… you're interesting, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet admission. Words come a bit slower, like he's choosing them carefully. Not quite a compliment on the surface, but the tone underneath is genuine. Slight vulnerability in the trailing pause.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、不良グループの親分やってたな
lines.en: Wait — were you actually running with a delinquent gang as the boss?
lines.style: Sharp, disbelieving. Quick attack on the opening. Eyebrows up — this is new information and she's catching it like she just figured something out. Accusatory but playful.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、両足ともサッカーで動けるな、桜
lines.en: You've got amazing control with both feet on the soccer field, Sakura.
lines.style: Direct compliment with warmth underneath. Confident, steady delivery. The tone of someone who doesn't often praise but means it fully when he does. Close, almost intimate in its sincerity.
